desc: A penguin-shaped spirit: round pale white body, black void face with two big white dot eyes, small gold ring on flipper, tiny lavender crystal on head. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
